courses.title: Failure Analysis
courses.course_description: This course provides comprehensive coverage of both the "how" and "why" of metal and ceramic failures and gives students the intellectual tools and practical understanding needed to analyze failures from a structural point of view. Its proven methods of examination and analysis enable students to reach correct, fact-based conclusions on the causes of metal failures, present and defend these conclusions before highly critical bodies, and suggest design improvements that may prevent future failures. Analytical methods presented in the course include stress analysis, fracture mechanics, fatigue analysis, corrosion science, and nondestructive testing. Numerous case studies illustrate the application of basic principles of metallurgy and failure analysis to a wide variety of real-world situations.

courses.course_description: Vectors and matrices, systems of linear equations, linear transformations, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, systems of ordinary differential equations, decomposition of matrices, and functions of matrices. courses.title: Mthd & Apps of Deep Learning
courses.course_description: This course introduces the core concepts of deep learning and its applications across various engineering disciplines. Students will explore the fundamentals of deep neural networks and their relevance to engineering tasks. Key topics include Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for image-based analysis, Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) networks, and transformers for time-series data, Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) for creating synthetic data for testing systems, Variational Auto Encoders (VAEs) for dimensionality reduction in complex datasets, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for network systems and infrastructures, and Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for autonomous system optimization. The course culminates in a project where students apply deep learning techniques to solve a specific engineering problem, integrating theoretical knowledge with practical application.
